to learn". Every player-facing word is Jessica's, written 2026-10-08 on his "yeah write".
Her placeholders map onto this template's tokens unchanged in meaning: <DungeonLocation> (the
stash) is <FindPlace>, <TargetPlanet> is <Planet>, <OwnerPlace> and <BuyerPlace> as written.

place._theme: The OWNER (the Vale family). Peopled, and NOT infrastructure, so the buyer's pool below is disjoint from this one by construction: one requires the keyword the other excludes. Census 2026-10-08 on Defiant: 62 peopled POIs carrying RECenterLocRef + MapMarker, 36 infrastructure and 26 not. ⏳ Which side gets which is a PLACEHOLDER (Eliza's split on the numbers); Jessica's call on the fiction.
place._second: The FIND (the salvager's stash), any POI, as duo_delve05's find.
place._third: The BUYER (Curator Oduya's war room). Peopled AND infrastructure.

prose.name: Salvage: Service Medal on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A salvager stashed a war medal at the <FindPlace>. If it's engraved, somebody is missing it.

items._crateModel: PLACEHOLDER: testcase 01's freight crate. A salvager's stash may want something smaller; his eye.
items._centre: PLACEHOLDER, the owner's delivery point: Akila's memorial podium, z 0.00..1.22, STANDS (gen_inspect bounds 2026-10-08). Name is Eliza's placeholder; Jessica's to word.

beats.journal: The medal has a name on it, Sergeant Vale, and his service record lists family at the <OwnerPlace>. I should take it to them.

message.title: Service Medal
message.text: The medal is engraved on the back: SGT I. VALE, COLONY WAR. His service record lists next of kin as the Vale family, at the <OwnerPlace>.

beats.objective: Return the medal to the Vale family
beats.journal: I found Sergeant Idris Vale's Colony War medal in a salvager's stash and took it home to his family at the <OwnerPlace>.

message.title: Returned
message.text: Maren Vale turns her father's medal over twice, says nothing for a while, and puts it in her pocket. She pays what she can.

beats.objective: Sell the medal to Curator Oduya
beats.journal: I found Sergeant Idris Vale's Colony War medal in a salvager's stash and sold it to Curator Oduya for his war room.

message.title: Sold
message.text: Oduya pays in full and packs it away for the war room. The card is already written: SGT IDRIS VALE, and the years.

offer.journal: The medal has a name on it, Sergeant Vale, and his service record lists family at the <OwnerPlace>. Word travels fast. A curator called Oduya wants the medal for his war room and will pay more than the family can. It's my call.
offer._journal: His play 2026-10-08: "the log doesn't read quite right, I think the family delivery one is skipped". The log shows only the NEWEST stage's line, and the driver sets 50 (the family line) and 60 (this one) in the same instant, so 50 is never seen. So this line carries both of Jessica's sentences, verbatim, family first; her "I should take it to them" is dropped as the one clause the choice contradicts. ⏳ Jessica's to reword as one line if she likes.

message.title: Incoming Message
message.text: Heard you turned up a Vale medal. I keep a small war room back home. People come to see it. I'm at the <BuyerPlace> now. I'll pay more than the family can, and it goes on the wall with his name under it. - Oduya

_people: His playtest 2026-10-08: "Returning the medal talks about a person who isn't there", then "FrankyCLI has npc creation tools". Templates are from NPCTools.GetTemplateFriendlyNPC's talkable set. ⏳ "Vale's Daughter" is a PLACEHOLDER: Jessica's prose never names her, so the name is hers to give (checked against his who's-who, no family name). Oduya is her name.
_reward: Overtime's own ladder, on each ending's completing stage (QRCR/QRXP): easy 1,250 cr / 250 xp, med 2,800 / 500, hard 7,500 / 1,500. His first play 2026-10-08 paid 1,250 + 2,500 on the buyer's ending, because the stage reward the base carries was copied to it AND the driver paid on top; the driver pays nothing now. ⏳ PLACEHOLDER TIERS, his to set: the buyer one rung above the owner, which is the design's only rule.
